Fig. 7: PCA visualizations of axial feature maps extracted directly from different pre-trained models on chest CT volumes. The arrows indicate representative lesion regions. Compared with prior methods, ASAP produces feature responses that exhibit clearer spatial localization and stronger semantic distinction around lesion-related regions.

Fig. 3: Quantitative comparison on the severe disease prediction task on the STOIC-2021 dataset [96]. The AUC (%) is reported under varying label ratios, reflecting different levels of annotation availability. Error bars represent the standard deviation over five independent runs.
